protocol.selectionRule: Among thresholds retaining at least 60% of development selections at 5/5, maximize descriptive Wilson lower bound of hit rate; ties use smaller thresholds. Lock before evaluating later dates.
protocol.candidateRule: Most recent earlier box roster; no selected-day results, participation or injuries used. DNP counts as a missed selection, separately reported.
protocol.firstBasketConditionalRule: Separate sensitivity only: filter earlier eligible candidates to eventual final-box starters; never included in pregame metrics or tuning.
protocol.limits: Corrected 2025-26 archive was already inspected. Retrospective time-ordered holdout, not unseen live evidence. No 2024-25 gamebook archive to validate cross-season fallback.
protocol.weights: Keep one-third offense, defense and opportunity. No weight optimization.

first-team-basket.priorSeasonFallbackPerformance: Unavailable: no verified 2024-25 archive. Fallback is labeled descriptive history, not a validated cross-season forecast.

positionEvidence.limitation: Pregame tests exclude later canonical season-role references. NBA gamebooks frequently supply only G/F; dated specific-role history is sparse. These tests have limited guard/wing coverage and do not validate all-position or cross-season performance.

conclusion: Readiness thresholds describe retrospective sample adequacy. Equal market weights retained; no calibrated matchup or joint probabilities claimed. Non-positive/constant correlations remain excluded by the user requirement even if ablations do not show an improvement.
